title: Bad restriction weight
statement: Let $\varphi$ be a DNF formula on $n$ coordinates and let $\delta\in\mathbb R$. Its bad restriction weight is the sum, over all restrictions on which $\varphi$ is nonconstant, of the assignment weight at parameter $\delta$ of that restriction.
caveat: The snippet does not include the definition of the assignment weight, so its precise dependence on the restriction and $\delta$ is unavailable.
